channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-130478 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | Joomla Extension - onlinecommunityhub.nl - Unrestricted write of downloaded remote files into a public folder in ochResponsiveImages extension 1.0.0-4.2.0 - With "Include Remote Images" enabled, the plugin wrote downloaded remote files into the public image cache folder without verifying that the URL and the content were an image. Fixed in 4.2.1, which only stores JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images.

item.title: CVE-2026-130479 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Joomla Extension - onlinecommunityhub.nl - Server-side request forgery via image check bypass in ochOpenGraph extension 1.0.0-3.1.0 - The image check meant to prevent server-side requests to internal addresses could be bypassed through a redirect, an internal IPv6 address or a remote image URL containing the site address, allowing content authors to make the server send requests to internal systems. Fixed in 3.1.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-133333 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unpaid order confirmation via PayPal Checkout order completion task in VirtueMart extension 4.0.0-4.8.8 - The ordercompleted task of the bundled PayPal Checkout payment plugin set the order held in the current checkout session to the configured success status without verifying a PayPal capture or authorization. A shopper, including a guest, could therefore mark their own unpaid order as confirmed and paid. Fixed in 4.8.10.

item.title: CVE-2026-133334 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Cross-product paid file download in Download Simple plugin in VirtueMart extension 4.0.0-4.8.0 - The bundled iStraxx Download Simple plugin verified the order secret of a download link against the order item, but not that the requested media belonged to that item. Anyone holding one valid download link could download other files offered for sale. Fixed in 4.8.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-133335 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unauthenticated local file inclusion leading to remote code execution via controller fallback in VirtueMart extension 4.0.0-4.8.7 - The main controller of the component fell back to including a controller file derived from the request without filtering the name, allowing path traversal to arbitrary local PHP files. Depending on the server setup, for example an available pearcmd.php, this could be used to execute code. The issue has been exploited in the wild. Fixed in 4.8.8.

item.title: CVE-2026-133737 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability reflected in the usuario[nombre] parameter of the actualizar_cuenta function in the functions.php endpoint. The application does not properly sanitise the received content, meaning that an authenticated user can inject JavaScript code which is reflected in the web interface and in the JSON responses. If another user views the affected content, the code may be executed within the context of their browser.

item.title: CVE-2026-133738 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | Vulnerability involving the exposure of sensitive information in the ver_usuarios endpoint. The JSON response includes data that is not required for the query and which should remain restricted, such as Argon2id password hashes, TOTP secrets, internal configuration flags, email addresses, telephone numbers and dates of last access. An authenticated user querying this resource can access this confidential information, which is sent directly to the web client.

item.title: CVE-2026-133739 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Error-based SQL injection vulnerability in the text parameter of the ver_usuarios endpoint. The SQL query is constructed from user-controlled data without proper validation or parameterisation. An authenticated user could submit a specially crafted input that triggers visible SQL errors in the response, including SQLSTATE[42S22] messages and references to columns in the query.
